document_title: Spot Bitcoin ETP approval market note
summary: The SEC approved the listing and trading of several spot bitcoin exchange-traded product shares. While BTC is not in the panel universe, the approval is expected to impact broader crypto market liquidity, ETF inflow expectations, policy sentiment, and risk appetite.
